name: Document
why: A doc, from written visual first to linted, mapped to its files, published, read and loaded
ideal: Every fact a reader needs is present, correct and current, in short, visual docs a person finishes in two minutes and Claude loads cheaply.

sources.title: GitHub Docs: About the repository README file

steps.name: Write
steps.rule: Visual first: a diagram or table carries the facts; text only labels and captions them.

steps.name: Lint
steps.rule: Every doc passes the content lint before it merges.

steps.name: Map
steps.rule: Each doc names the files it covers, so a change to them flags the doc.

steps.name: Publish
steps.rule: A published doc has no broken link or anchor.

steps.name: Read
tools: Reading time at 238 words a minute
steps.rule: A person finishes each doc in two minutes.

steps.name: Load
tools: Agent docs: CLAUDE.md, skills and rules
steps.rule: Claude loads no tokens past a doc's reading goal.
